text: You're looking for a quick and delicious meal that fits your vegetarian diet and health goal of increasing your fiber intake. This Simple and Delicious Low Fat Vegetarian Chili recipe checks all the boxes. It's made with black beans, which are an excellent source of fiber, and is ready in under 35 minutes, fitting your time budget. The recipe also features a variety of vegetables, including carrots and corn, which add natural sweetness and texture. With only 8g of fat and 23g of carbs, this chili is a nutritious and satisfying option for you.
